title: First cotangent homology of a surjection
statement: Let $A\twoheadrightarrow B$ be a surjective homomorphism of commutative rings with kernel $I$, and let $\mathrm{NL}_{B/A}=(J/J^2\xrightarrow{\ \delta\ }\bigoplus_{b\in B}B\,\mathrm d[b])$ be the naive cotangent complex of the canonical presentation $\gamma:A[B]\to B$, $[b]\mapsto b$, with kernel $J$, and $H_1(L_{B/A})=\ker\delta$, as in [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. Then there is a canonical isomorphism of $B$-modules $$H_1(L_{B/A})\;\cong\;I/I^2,$$ namely: choose for each $b\in B$ a preimage $\sigma(b)\in A$; the $A$-algebra map $\varphi:A[B]\to A$, $[b]\mapsto\sigma(b)$, satisfies $\varphi(J)\subseteq I$, and the isomorphism sends the class of $g\in J$ with $g\bmod J^2\in\ker\delta$ to $\varphi(g)\bmod I^2$; it does not depend on the choice of $\sigma$. Moreover the module of K\"ahler differentials vanishes, $\Omega_{B/A}=0$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], so the cokernel of $\delta$ is zero.
